-- plain --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x$A
-- env --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
WORKDIR x$A
-- braced --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
WORKDIR x${A}y
-- default-unset --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x${A:-dev}
-- default-empty --
FROM alpine
ENV A=""
WORKDIR x${A:-dev}
-- default-empty-no-colon --
FROM alpine
ENV A=""
WORKDIR x${A-dev}
-- default-set --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
WORKDIR x${A:-dev}
-- alternative-set --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
WORKDIR x${A:+alt}
-- alternative-unset --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x${A:+alt}
-- alternative-empty-no-colon --
FROM alpine
ENV A=""
WORKDIR x${A+alt}
-- nested-default --
FROM alpine
ENV B=two
WORKDIR x${A:-$B}
-- nested-braced-default --
FROM alpine
ENV B=two
WORKDIR x${A:-${B}-z}
-- env-from-env --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
ENV B=${A}/two
WORKDIR x$B
-- env-same-line --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one B=$A
WORKDIR x$B
-- env-default-at-definition --
FROM alpine
ENV APP_HOME=${VERSION:-dev}
WORKDIR $APP_HOME
-- quoted-double --
FROM alpine
ENV A="two words"
WORKDIR "x$A"
-- quoted-single --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
WORKDIR 'x$A'
-- escaped-dollar --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one
WORKDIR x\$A
-- escape-in-double-quotes --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR "x\a\$b\"c"
-- legacy-env --
FROM alpine
ENV A legacy value
WORKDIR "x$A"
-- arg-default --
FROM alpine
ARG A=one
WORKDIR x$A
-- arg-from-preamble --
ARG A=pre
FROM alpine
ARG A
WORKDIR x$A
-- preamble-not-visible --
ARG A=pre
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x$A
-- arg-without-default --
FROM alpine
ARG A
WORKDIR x${A-unset}
-- env-beats-arg --
FROM alpine
ENV A=env
ARG A=arg
WORKDIR x$A
-- env-inherited --
FROM alpine AS base
ENV A=one
FROM base
WORKDIR x$A
-- arg-not-inherited --
FROM alpine AS base
ARG A=one
FROM base
WORKDIR x${A-gone}
-- env-after-workdir --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x$A
ENV A=late
-- unknown-platform --
FROM alpine
ARG TARGETARCH
WORKDIR x$TARGETARCH
-- unknown-pattern --
FROM alpine
ENV A=one.two
WORKDIR x${A%.*}
-- lone-dollar --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x$
-- dollar-digit --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x$1y
-- arg-same-line --
FROM alpine
ARG A=one B=$A
WORKDIR x$B
-- preamble-arg-same-line --
ARG A=one B=$A
FROM alpine
ARG B
WORKDIR x$B
-- preamble-arg-later --
ARG B=$A
ARG A=one
FROM alpine
ARG B
WORKDIR x$B
-- dollar-digit-braced --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x${1}y
-- dollar-digits-braced --
FROM alpine
WORKDIR x${12}y
-- default-path --
FROM scratch
WORKDIR x$PATH
